_purpose: Phase-3 Claude-only deepening probe — adds 3 attempts per Claude cell to bring Phase-3 sample to n=6 per (problem × target) cell. Carved from manifest.phase3-no-codex.json by dropping the gemini agent. Tightens within-Claude estimates for postmortem-004's three load-bearing claims: (1) Claude × LLMLL 4/9 vs Claude × Python 9/9 split (target-reached rates); (2) within-Claude strategy-variance distribution (verified-into-tier vs tested-into-tier, currently resting on n=2 high-verified anecdotes — cells 12 and 20 of the original batch); (3) within-Claude H2 refutation (LLMLL not faster to converge — load-bearing). Hole-fill: Claude × Go × 003 ran 0 attempts in Phase-3 due to F-037 breaker-collateral; this batch will run 3 attempts for that cell as well, bringing it to n=3 (vs n=6 for the other 8 Claude cells). Combined Phase-3 + deepening dataset will be the source for postmortem-005. Cell count this batch: 3 problems × 3 targets × 3 attempts = 27 cells. Predicted wall: 4-7h + interim pauses. Predicted spend: ~$0 on Claude max-subscription; ~$30-80 if any cell overages. Tests no new hypotheses — descriptive tightening only.
_timeout_note: Bumped from 540 to 1800 per postmortem-002-phase3-calibration-probe.md F-035 (2026-05-15). Preserved verbatim from manifest.phase3-no-codex.json for run-comparability.

terminal_target._note: Default applied when no per-target override matches. The matrix spans mixed verification surfaces; see `terminal_target_per_target` below.

llmll._s1_note: R6d universal Cred predicate. Encoded per language-team S1 default (Phase-3 scope-decision framing, 2026-05-15). `asserted` is dropped from the accepted-levels set per scripts/run_repair_loop.py:_count_bad_trust_tiers.

toolchain_pins._note: Pin verification enforced by run_matrix.py:check_prereqs at matrix start. Verified 2026-05-20 against `llmll version` (0.10.6) — matches Phase-3 launch pin.

_circuit_breaker_note: Stop-fast discipline B (per-cell circuit breaker): if N consecutive cells return terminal_state=infrastructure-fail, abort the matrix and write a partial matrix_report.json with a `circuit_breaker_tripped` field. Default N=3.
_pause_note: Stop-fast discipline D (interim-pause checkpoint): after every K cells, write an interim matrix_report.json and exit with status `paused`. Operator resumes with --resume-from-cell. K=9 corresponds to one full agent×problem×target slice for one try. Set to null/0 to disable.

_audit_pin._note: Phase-3 audit pin carried verbatim from manifest.phase3-no-codex.json. Deepening probe shares the same launch-commit hash for verification-path-engagement audit (4078b76 — F-040 path 1 fix HEAD, locked at Phase-3 launch).
